files.docs/sync-protocol.md:
# Sync protocol

## Push
Devices send batches of outbox entries to POST /sync/push.

## Pull
Devices fetch changes after their cursor from GET /sync/pull.

## Cursor choice
Device clocks drift by minutes after days offline and inspectors cross time zones between sites, so changes are ordered by a server-assigned sequence number, never by device timestamps.

# fieldsync

Offline-first sync service for the field-inspection mobile app.

## Local setup

    npm install
    npm test
    npm start

The server listens on port 8080 and stores data in ./data/fieldsync.db.

files.docs/conflicts.md:
# Conflict policy (draft)

When two devices edit the same inspection, the write with the higher server sequence wins and replaces the whole record.
The losing version is kept in history for support.

files.docs/rollout.md:
# Field rollout

- Each customer is a tenant; no record may cross tenants.
- Photos move out of the database into object storage.
- Old app versions (v1.x) stay supported for one season.
- Devices must free space once records are safely on the server.
